summary: Iteration 12 backend + frontend testing complete. All 17 backend pytest cases pass (chat spam gating, agent-handoff full lifecycle, ack auth, custom scripts index.html marker rewriting, portal ticket 401 gating, regressions). Frontend flows verified: chatbot spam inline notice, normal reply, agent handoff panel + POST → 'Thanks — an agent is on the way!' confirmation, Admin /admin/scripts save PUT 200, CustomScriptsInjector runtime footer injection works, /portal/ticket/{fake} shows expected error card with back button, /portal shows Zoho login, /voorwaarden renders 14 Artikel N headings in NL. Live index.html cleaned to empty markers as instructed.

integration_issues.issue: Header <meta> tags are not injected into <head> at runtime because they are placed inside a temporary <div>.innerHTML before being appended; browsers do not preserve <meta> elements as children of <div>. Footer injection (span/script) works fine. SSR path (public/index.html marker rewrite) works correctly for meta tags — so this only affects the client-side fallback when a user changes scripts without hard-reloading. Recommended fix: for header content, parse the HTML with new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html').head.children and clone into document.head.

action_items: (Optional) Improve CustomScriptsInjector to correctly clone <meta>/<link> tags into <head> using DOMParser (currently only <script> and generic elements survive innerHTML on a <div>). SSR path is unaffected, so Trustpilot/GTM crawlers still see header meta correctly.

Note: FE fetch of https://<host>/index.html serves the CRA dev-server bundled template (from HTMLWebpackPlugin memory), NOT the on-disk /app/frontend/public/index.html. This means the /index.html URL will not reflect script changes in the preview environment until a webpack rebuild. In production build (yarn build), the disk file IS what gets served — so backend disk write logic (verified by pytest) is correct for production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/chat returns HTTP 400 for spam (not 200 with status='blocked' as review description suggested). Frontend Chatbot.jsx correctly handles 400 with detail.reason and displays inline notice — behavior is consistent end-to-end.
Chat rate-limit anti-flood (2s per IP) trips easily with parallel test workers; pytest run with -o addopts="" (single worker) or with retries. Consider allowing test-mode bypass via header for CI.

server.py:1132 PUT /api/admin/scripts writes to /app/frontend/public/index.html on disk — good for production static hosting. In dev/preview environment, CRA dev server caches the template so the served /index.html lags; harmless but worth documenting for humans debugging.
CustomScriptsInjector.jsx uses div.innerHTML which loses <meta> and <link> tags when appending to <head> — see integration_issues above.
openapi.json is not exposed via the Kubernetes ingress (only /api/* is proxied to backend). Test adapted to verify route existence via 401 responses instead.
